title: Keto Redcurrant Crumble
description: A delicious keto dessert featuring fresh redcurrants topped with a crunchy crumble made from almond flour and sweetened with sugar-free sweetener.

ingredients.name: Sugar-free sweetener (such as Swerve or Erythritol)

instructions: Rinse the redcurrants and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a large bowl, mix together the almond flour, sugar-free sweetener, and crumbles.
Add the melted butter to the bowl and mix until a crumbly mixture forms.
Pour the redcurrant mixture into a baking dish and top with the crumble mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the crumble is golden brown.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with lemon zest and vanilla extract if desired.
